UpdateStageDescription: Check and install Git, Git LFS, and Java 11 if missing
UpdateSourceArgs:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo "=== 2009Scape Prerequisites ==="

# --- Git ---
if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Git missing → installing..."
  (sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq git) || \
  (apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git) || \
  echo "WARNING: Could not install Git"
else
  echo "Git OK"
fi

# --- Git LFS ---
if ! command -v git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Git LFS missing → installing..."
  (sudo apt-get install -y -qq git-lfs) || \
  (apt-get install -y -qq git-lfs) || \
  echo "WARNING: Could not install Git LFS"
else
  echo "Git LFS OK"
fi
git lfs install || true

# --- Java 11 ---
JAVA11=false
if command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  VER=$(java -version 2>&1 | head -n1)
  echo "Found: $VER"
  if echo "$VER" | grep -q 'version "11'; then
    JAVA11=true
  fi
fi

if [ "$JAVA11" = false ]; then
  echo "Java 11 not found → trying AMP method..."
  if command -v getamp >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    getamp installJava || echo "getamp installJava failed (may need root)"
  else
    echo "getamp not found → trying apt..."
    (sudo apt-get install -y -qq temurin-11-jdk) || \
    (apt-get install -y -qq openjdk-11-jdk) || \
    echo "WARNING: Could not install Java 11"
  fi
else
  echo "Java 11 OK"
fi

echo "=== Prerequisites finished ==="
